en.summary: A command-line tool that finds hardcoded secrets in code and moves them into environment variables.
en.role: Designer and maintainer. I scoped it, wrote the acceptance checks, and published it.
en.built: About seven in ten commits are co-authored by Claude Code. A plan review and a real install test found nine defects the unit tests could not see. One auto-fix passed its own test while writing a string instead of an environment reference.
en.figure: Simplified design diagram. The accent step exists because an earlier fix passed its test and still produced wrong code.
